name: Should I repair or repipe my entire home for a slab leak?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or repipe my entire home for a slab leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair a specific slab leak or repipe your entire home depends on several factors, including the age and condition of your existing plumbing system, the frequency of past leaks, and your long-term plans for the property. If your pipes are old and prone to multiple leaks, a full repipe might be a more cost-effective long-term solution. For an isolated leak in otherwise sound plumbing, a targeted repair is often sufficient. We can help you assess the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a full repipe if your plumbing is old and frequently leaks. For an isolated leak in good pipes, a targeted repair may be sufficient.
